title: geonoma orbignyana subsp. hoffmanniana
intro: Geonoma orbignyana subsp. hoffmanniana, commonly known as the "Coquillo" palm, is a subspecies of palm tree that belongs to the family Arecaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, fever, and pain, making it a natural remedy for various health issues. The health benefits of Geonoma orbignyana subsp. hoffmanniana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to fully understand its composition and potential uses.
